# GameXR

GameXR is a browser-local configurable spatial flight runtime.

Browser WebMCP tools:
- gamexr.inspect_runtime: read-only local manifest, flight/performance telemetry, chase-camera pose/FOV, animation, and zero-spend evidence.
- gamexr.control_runtime: bounded local transport, controls, animation, and validated manifest patching.

Canonical invocation discovery:
- /tool.catalog #tool-function @tool-function
- /tool.call #bridge-tool #tool-routing #approval-gate @bridge-tool @tool-function @tool-policy @cost-log

/flight.sim @canvas #flight remains owned by the AgenticGraph Canvas runtime and is not an alias for GameXR.

Device-orientation steering requires the visible direct-gesture Enable Motion control. MCP can tune the manifest preference, sensitivity, dead zone, and pitch inversion, but cannot grant Safari sensor permission or start a sensor listener.

Automated browser proof can target an exact deployed URL and verify artifact hashes, online convergence of the content-addressed offline cache, and chase-camera telemetry. A separate disposable local-origin test proves real offline navigation/reload. Neither is physical iPhone or Vision Pro certification.

No GameXR browser tool grants network egress, filesystem access, model calls, paid calls, repository mutation, Production projection, or Cloudflare deployment.
